task: file-localization adaptation; NOT the official function-generation metric
notes: File-localization adaptation, not official RepoQA SNF scores or SWE-bench issue-resolution rates.
Fixed queries and same source files across methods; gold labels are used only after ranking.
grep is a deterministic literal OR/count baseline, not agentic grep.
Dense is retrieval only (no generator); model and build costs recorded separately. Deterministic baselines run once; s1s repeats.
Errors count as misses. Context bytes measure full top-5 files, not tokenizer-accurate prompt length.
TypeSafe cost is estimated from reported successful usage; failed/retried calls may have unreported cost.
